verdict.rationale: Scribe's API accepts a natural-language instruction that it applies to the final transcript and returns as 'edited_transcript'. An official ElevenLabs MCP server is also documented, which lets AI clients drive the product conversationally. However, the native natural-language command covers only post-transcription editing, not operating the product as a whole. missing for 10: natural-language control of core operations (starting jobs, configuring options) within the product itself, documentation of what the MCP server exposes for Scribe, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Natural-language instruction applied to the final transcript (max 2000 characters). The edited text is returned in 'edited_transcript' alongside the original transcript.
